name: Bermuda Triangle
story: The Bermuda Triangle is a loosely defined region in the western part of the North Atlantic Ocean where a number of aircraft and ships are said to have disappeared under mysterious circumstances.

name: Alaska Triangle
story: The Alaska Triangle is a region of wilderness in Alaska where a number of aircraft and boats have disappeared under mysterious circumstances. It is often compared to the Bermuda Triangle.

name: Michigan Triangle
story: The Michigan Triangle is a region of Lake Michigan where a number of ships and aircraft have disappeared under mysterious circumstances. It is often compared to the Bermuda Triangle.

name: Dragon's Triangle
story: The Dragon's Triangle, also known as the Pacific Bermuda Triangle, is a region of the Pacific Ocean where a number of ships and aircraft have disappeared under mysterious circumstances. It is located near Japan and is often compared to the Bermuda Triangle.
